video.title: AI欧腐《他不是我的哥哥/Not My Brother》
video.desc:
After his mother remarries, 22-year-old Noah lives with same-age stepbrother Adrian. From irritation to undeniable attraction, they cross family lines. When their secret is exposed, they must decide: retreat or choose a life together on their own terms.
母亲再婚后，22岁的 Noah 与同龄的继兄 Adrian 住到了同一屋檐下。从看不顺眼到无法否认的吸引，两人跨越了家人的界线。当秘密被揭穿，他们必须做出抉择：退回原地，还是按自己的方式选择一起生活。
